Class AddProduct

java.lang.Object
aparicio.controller.AddProduct

public class AddProduct extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
This class adds a product with an associated parts list to the allProducts list.

    • initialize

      public void initialize(URL url, ResourceBundle resourceBundle)

      Specified by:
      initialize in interface javafx.fxml.Initializable

    • onInvPartsSearch2

      public void onInvPartsSearch2(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method searches the Parts list. It calls the lookUpPart method from Inventory Model class, returns a list of matches and searches by Part ID and Name.

    • onAddAssocPt

      public void onAddAssocPt(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method adds a part to the associated parts list. It copies a part from the top tableView and adds it to the bottom tableView. It also has an Alert message to make sure a part is selected.

    • onRemoveAssocPrt

      public void onRemoveAssocPrt(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      This method removes a part from the associated parts list. It permanently deletes the selected part from the associated parts list and displays an Alert message to confirm deletion.

    • onSaveProd

      public void onSaveProd(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException
      This method adds and saves a product to the all products list. It saves the data from the text fields, creates a Product object, links the associated parts list to this object, and redirects to the main screen.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • backToMain

      public void backToMain(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException
      This method is called when the Cancel button is clicked. It cancels the add product request and redirects to the main screen.
      Throws:
      IOException
